player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} ({role}) in a {num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies game.
- Each round, submit [heads] or [tails] (or [h], [t]).
- If your choice matches your opponent’s, Player 0 wins the round; otherwise Player 1 wins.
Reply with your choice in the format '[heads]' or '[tails]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: غلط فارميٽ؛ مهرباني ڪري "[heads]" يا "[tails]" داخل ڪريو.

message.round_match: پليئر 0 چونڊيو {choice0}؛ پليئر 1 چونڊيو {choice1}. ميچ -> پليئر 0 کٽي ٿو
message.round_mismatch: پليئر 0 چونڊيو {choice0}؛ پليئر 1 چونڊيو {choice1}. ناڪامي -> پليئر 1 کٽي ٿو.

outcome.draw: مجموعي طور تي راند هڪڙي آهي.
